name: golden/capture-help
stdout:
Capture Go command output.

Usage:
  wowdata golden capture [flags]

Examples:
  wowdata golden capture --name db2-spellname-123 -- wowdata db2 rows SpellName --id 123

Flags:
      --command string    Command to execute and capture
  -h, --help              help for capture
      --manifest string   Golden manifest path to update
      --name string       Fixture name
      --output string     Fixture output path

Global Flags:
      --auto-warmup              Deprecated compatibility flag; data commands prepare required cache automatically
      --build string             WoW build: latest, version, build ID, or config key (required unless --profile is used)
      --cache string             Cache directory override; defaults to ~/.wowdata/cache
      --dbd-manifest             Also prepare the DBD manifest cache
      --listfile                 Also prepare the listfile cache
      --listfile-format string   Listfile source format: binary or text (default "binary")
      --locale string            WoW locale, such as zhCN or enUS (required unless --profile is used)
      --path string              Local WoW client path when source=local
      --product string           WoW product (required unless --profile is used)
      --profile string           Named target profile from ~/.wowdata/profiles
      --region string            WoW region (required unless --profile is used)
      --source string            Data source: local or remote (required unless --profile is used)
      --tables string            Additional comma-separated DB2 tables to prepare
